plan.planning_summary: Refining route_03 (28-layer HfO2/SiO2 dual-band filter) based on iteration_07 results showing best_target_score=0.819 with distinct thickness clusters: HfO2 layers ~150-200 nm, SiO2 layers ~55-73 nm. Three complementary routes implement feedback directives: (1) expanded SiO2 initialization bounds with variance regularization, (2) reduced 24-layer count to test performance-manufacturability tradeoff, (3) SiO2 outermost layer >=200 nm for environmental durability per literature evidence. All routes preserve dual-band spectral targets (high-T 1000-1700 nm, high-R 300-450 nm) and HfO2/SiO2 material restriction.

routes.title: 28-Layer Stack with Expanded SiO2 Initialization and Variance Regularization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Expanding low-index (SiO2) layer initialization bounds by ±25% while freezing high-index (HfO2) layers near their observed optimal cluster (150-200 nm) will increase the probability of landing within the dual-band feasible basin, and adding mild thickness variance regularization between adjacent layers will reduce numerically unstable oscillatory solutions that consume computational budget.
routes.design_principle: Asymmetric initialization strategy: SiO2 layers initialized with wider bounds to explore thickness space more thoroughly, HfO2 layers initialized near converged values from iteration_07 to preserve learned optima. Variance penalty discourages abrupt thickness jumps that cause numerical convergence issues.
routes.proposed_topology: 28 finite layers on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 HfO2 + 14 SiO2). No protective capping layer specified.
design_variables: all 28 layer thicknesses with asymmetric initialization bounds
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
minimize thickness variance between adjacent layers
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds: HfO2 120-230 nm, SiO2 40-95 nm
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
Dual-band filter design requires non-quarter-wave optimization
expected_advantages: Wider SiO2 search space increases feasible basin capture probability
Preserves HfO2 optima from prior iteration
known_risks: Regularization may constrain optimizer from finding global optimum
Wider bounds may increase convergence time
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer HfO2/SiO2 multilayer coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 bilayers). Initialize HfO2 layer thicknesses uniformly in range 120-230 nm. Initialize SiO2 layer thicknesses uniformly in range 40-95 nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with objective: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Add regularization penalty proportional to variance of thickness differences between adjacent layers (weight=0.01). Use smatrix solver with unpolarized normal incidence. Total layer count fixed at 28. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: expand SiO2 initialization bounds by ±25% (from ~55-73 nm observed cluster to 40-95 nm), freeze HfO2 near observed optimal cluster (120-230 nm encompasses 150-200 nm), add thickness variance regularization to reduce numerical instability.

routes.title: 24-Layer Reduced Count Stack for Manufacturability Tradeoff Analysis
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 28 to 24 (12 bilayers) will maintain acceptable dual-band performance while improving manufacturability and reducing total coating thickness, as the marginal performance gain from layers 25-28 may not justify added fabrication complexity.
routes.design_principle: Layer count reduction test: if 24 layers achieve >90% of 28-layer performance, the 4-layer reduction improves yield and reduces stress without significant optical penalty. Uses same asymmetric initialization strategy as route_03_ref_01.
routes.proposed_topology: 24 finite layers on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (12 HfO2 + 12 SiO2). No protective capping layer specified.
design_variables: all 24 layer thicknesses with asymmetric initialization bounds
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds: HfO2 120-230 nm, SiO2 40-95 nm
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack reflectivity scales with layer pair count
Diminishing returns beyond optimal layer count for given bandwidth
expected_advantages: Faster optimization convergence with fewer variables
known_risks: Dual-band performance may degrade significantly with 4 fewer layers
May not achieve iteration_07 target_score of 0.819

Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (12 bilayers). routes.title: 28-Layer Stack with SiO2 Outermost Layer >= 200 nm for Environmental Durability
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Terminating the stack with a SiO2 outermost layer of thickness >= 200 nm will provide environmental durability per literature evidence while maintaining dual-band optical performance, as the thick low-index capping layer minimally affects spectral response at target bands.
routes.design_principle: Environmental durability enhancement: evidence indicates SiO2 outermost layer >= 200 nm improves coating stability. This route tests whether durability constraint can be satisfied without significant optical performance degradation.
routes.proposed_topology: 28 finite layers on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 HfO2 + 14 SiO2). Outermost SiO2 layer constrained to >= 200 nm thickness.
design_variables: all 28 layer thicknesses with outermost SiO2 >= 200 nm constraint
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
minimize deviation of outermost SiO2 from 200 nm target
manufacturing_considerations: outermost SiO2 layer thickness >= 200 nm for durability
thickness bounds: HfO2 120-230 nm, SiO2 (inner) 40-95 nm, SiO2 (outer) 200-300 nm
theory_basis: Outermost low-index layer protects underlying stack from environmental exposure
Thick capping layer has minimal spectral impact if positioned at field node
expected_advantages: SiO2 is mechanically robust and chemically stable
known_risks: 200 nm outermost layer may shift spectral response at band edges
May require re-optimization of underlying layers to compensate
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer HfO2/SiO2 multilayer coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 bilayers). Initialize HfO2 layer thicknesses uniformly in range 120-230 nm. Initialize inner SiO2 layers (layers 2-27) uniformly in range 40-95 nm. Constrain outermost SiO2 layer (layer 28) to thickness >= 200 nm, initialized in range 200-300 nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with objective: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Use smatrix solver with unpolarized normal incidence. Total layer count fixed at 28. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Implements literature evidence for environmental durability (SiO2 outermost >= 200 nm) while preserving dual-band optimization. Tests whether durability constraint is compatible with optical performance targets.
